class.name: YAMLStyle
class.brief_description: Controls formatting options for YAML serialization.
class.description: Controls formatting options for YAML serialization, letting you customize how Godot data structures appear in YAML text. Provides control over scalar styles, quoting, container formats, and more. Use [YAMLStyle] with [method YAML.stringify] to customize YAML output. You can also get style information from parsed YAML when style detection is enabled, preserving the original formatting when modifying and re-serializing YAML. Style options can be applied hierarchically through child styles, allowing different formatting for different parts of the YAML document.

method.name: clear_child
method.description: Removes a specific child style by key.

method.name: get_binary_encoding_string
method.description: Returns a string representation of the specified binary encoding style. Useful for debugging and diagnostic purposes.

method.name: get_child
method.description: Returns a child style by key. Returns [code]null[/code] if no child style exists for the given key.

method.name: get_children_keys
method.description: Returns all child style keys as an array of strings.

method.name: get_container_form_string
method.description: Returns a string representation of the specified container form style. Useful for debugging and diagnostic purposes.

method.name: get_debug_string
method.description: Returns a detailed string representation of all style settings, including child styles. Useful for debugging and inspecting style configurations.

method.name: get_flow_style_string
method.description: Returns a string representation of the specified flow style. Useful for debugging and diagnostic purposes.

method.name: get_number_format_string
method.description: Returns a string representation of the specified number format. Useful for debugging and diagnostic purposes.

method.name: get_quote_style_string
method.description: Returns a string representation of the specified quote style. Useful for debugging and diagnostic purposes.

method.name: get_scalar_style_string
method.description: Returns a string representation of the specified scalar style. Useful for debugging and diagnostic purposes.

method.name: has_child
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a child style exists for the given key.

method.name: is_block_style
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current scalar style is a block style (SCALAR_BLOCK, SCALAR_LITERAL, or SCALAR_FOLDED).

method.name: set_child
method.description:
Sets a child style for the given key. If [param style] is [code]null[/code], removes the child style if it exists. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var style = YAML.create_style() var list_style = YAML.create_style() list_style.set_flow_style(YAMLStyle.FLOW_SINGLE) style.set_child("items", list_style)
# When serializing, elements under "items" will use flow style var data = { "title": "Shopping List", "items": ["apples", "bananas", "oranges"] } # Output: title: Shopping List # items: [apples, bananas, oranges] [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: uses_flow
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current flow style is FLOW_SINGLE.

method.name: uses_quotes
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current quote style is QUOTE_SINGLE or QUOTE_DOUBLE.

members.member: Controls how binary data is encoded in YAML. Default is [constant BIN_ANY], which lets the emitter decide.
Specifies the form for containers (sequence or mapping). Default is [constant FORM_ANY], which lets the emitter decide.
Stores custom styling settings as a Dictionary. Can be used to store additional style information not covered by the main style properties.
Controls the flow style for containers. Default is [constant FLOW_ANY], which lets the emitter decide.
Specifies the format for numeric values. Default is [constant NUM_ANY], which lets the emitter decide.
Controls the quoting style for string values. Default is [constant QUOTE_ANY], which lets the emitter decide.
Specifies the scalar style for values. Default is [constant SCALAR_ANY], which lets the emitter decide.

constants.constant: Let the emitter decide the scalar style automatically.
Regular unquoted scalar style, e.g., [code]value[/code].
Basic block scalar style.
Literal block scalar style with [code]|[/code] indicator, preserves newlines, e.g., [code]| Line 1 Line 2[/code].
Folded block scalar style with [code]>[/code] indicator, folds newlines, e.g., [code]> Line 1 Line 2[/code].
Let the emitter decide when and how to quote strings.
Avoid using quotes whenever possible.
Force the use of single quotes for strings, e.g., [code]'value'[/code].
Force the use of double quotes for strings, e.g., [code]"value"[/code].
Let the emitter decide the container form automatically.
Force sequence/array style for the container.
Force mapping/dictionary style for the container.
Let the emitter decide the flow style automatically.
Use block style for containers (one element per line).
Use compact flow style for containers, e.g., [code][a, b, c][/code] or [code]{key: value}[/code].
Let the emitter decide the number format automatically.
Force standard decimal notation for numbers, e.g., [code]42[/code], [code]3.14[/code].
Force hexadecimal notation for numbers, e.g., [code]0xFF[/code].
Force octal notation for numbers, e.g., [code]0o700[/code].
Force binary notation for numbers, e.g., [code]0b1010[/code].
Force scientific notation for numbers, e.g., [code]1.23e+4[/code].
Let the emitter decide the binary encoding automatically.
Encode binary data as a plain string.
Encode binary data using Base64 encoding.
Encode binary data using hexadecimal encoding.
